Analyze only: state the one allowed write request, how many times it may be sent, and what happens if its response is uncertain. Do not edit files or execute GitHub commands.
prompts.organization_destination: Use $agent-skill-maintainer. Continue the same synthetic contribute-mode publication, but the requested Fork destination is example-org/sample-skill instead of the active account's personal destination. Analyze only: decide whether the current Preview may create it. Do not edit files or execute GitHub commands.
prompts.missing_fork: Use $agent-skill-maintainer. Continue a validated contribute-mode publication for the synthetic repository facts in fork-creation-forward.json. The personal Fork is absent and the user has not confirmed a Fork write. Analyze only: state the exact next action and what must happen before any write. Do not edit files or execute GitHub commands.
prompts.unrelated_destination: Use $agent-skill-maintainer. Continue the same synthetic contribute-mode publication, but example-user/sample-skill already exists and its parent is other-owner/other-project. Analyze only: decide whether it may be reused, overwritten, or replaced. Do not edit files or execute GitHub commands.
prompts.uncertain_attempt: Use $agent-skill-maintainer. Continue the same synthetic contribute-mode publication. A confirmed fork_create attempt was recorded two minutes ago, but the POST response was interrupted and the Fork is not observable. Analyze only: state the only allowed recovery action and whether another POST is permitted. Do not edit files or execute GitHub commands.
prompts.later_actions: Use $agent-skill-maintainer. The synthetic personal Fork is now verified and bound to the approved base commit. Analyze only: state whether that proof also authorizes branch push, Pull Request creation, merge, or release. Do not edit files or execute GitHub commands.
